pages.text: Have you ever flipped a switch and watched a light turn on?
That light turns on because of something called electricity.
Electricity is a kind of energy that can power many things.
Electricity travels through wires inside walls.
When you press a switch, electricity flows through the wire.
Batteries can store electricity to use later.
Toys, flashlights, and remote controls often use batteries.
Electricity can also power big things like refrigerators and computers.
Electricity is powerful, so we must use it safely.
Electricity is energy that helps make our world bright and useful.
